fullDesc: On November 22, 1986 Mike Tyson knocked out Trevor Berbick in the second round to become, at 20, the youngest heavyweight champion in history. He went on to unify the titles.
realFacts: He was trained by Cus D'Amato
He lost to Buster Douglas in 1990
He was convicted in 1992 and served three years
He bit Evander Holyfield's ear in 1997
